# Lockness Core

The heart of the Lockness framework providing essential MVC architecture, dependency injection, and complete Hono integration.

## Overview

@lockness/core is the foundation of Lockness, providing:

- **MVC Engine** - Class-based architecture with clean separation
- **Modern Decorators** - TC39 Stage 3 decorators (@Controller, @Get, @Service)
- **Powerful Routing** - Zero-configuration controller discovery
- **Dependency Injection** - Built-in IoC container (@Inject, @Service)
- **JSX Support** - Native JSX runtime for views and components
- **Named Routes** - Dynamic URL generation
- **Complete Hono Integration** - 61+ Hono middleware and utilities

## Minimal Core Philosophy

@lockness/core includes only essentials. Optional features are separate packages:

- **Included**: HTTP server, routing, DI, JSX, Hono middleware
- **Optional**: Sessions, queues, cache, logger, mail, storage, auth

Import optional packages explicitly when needed.

## Installation

```bash
# Create new project
deno run -A jsr:@lockness/cli init my-app

# Or add to existing deno.json
{
  "imports": {
    "@lockness/core": "jsr:@lockness/core@^0.1.0"
  }
}
```

## Quick Start

### Minimal Application

```typescript
// main.ts
import { App } from '@lockness/core'

const app = new App()

await app.init({
    controllersDir: './app/controller',
})

Deno.serve({ port: 8888 }, app.fetch)
```

### Application Kernel

```typescript
// app/kernel.tsx
import { App } from '@lockness/core'

export const bootstrap = async () => {
    const app = new App()

    await app.init({
        controllersDir: './app/controller',
        staticDir: 'public',
    })

    return app
}
```

## MVC Architecture

### Controllers

Define routes with decorators:

```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Post, Context } from '@lockness/core'

@Controller('/users')
export class UserController {
    @Get('/')
    index(c: Context) {
        return c.json({ users: [] })
    }

    @Get('/:id')
    show(c: Context) {
        const id = c.req.param('id')
        return c.json({ id })
    }

    @Post('/')
    async store(c: Context) {
        const data = await c.req.json()
        return c.json({ created: true }, 201)
    }
}
```

### Services

Business logic in injectable services:

```typescript
import { Service, Inject } from '@lockness/core'

@Service()
export class UserService {
    async findAll() {
        return await db.select().from(users)
    }

    async findById(id: number) {
        return await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, id))
    }
}
```

### Dependency Injection

Inject services into controllers:

```typescript
@Controller('/users')
export class UserController {
    @Inject(UserService)
    accessor userService!: UserService

    @Get('/:id')
    async show(c: Context) {
        const id = Number(c.req.param('id'))
        const user = await this.userService.findById(id)
        return c.json(user)
    }
}
```

### Views (JSX)

Server-side JSX components:

```typescript
// app/view/pages/home.tsx
export function HomePage() {
    return (
        <html>
            <head>
                <title>Lockness App</title>
            </head>
            <body>
                <h1>Welcome to Lockness</h1>
            </body>
        </html>
    )
}

// In controller
@Get('/')
home(c: Context) {
    return c.html(<HomePage />)
}
```

## Routing

### Route Decorators

```typescript
@Controller('/posts')
export class PostController {
    @Get('/')              // GET /posts
    @Get('/:id')           // GET /posts/:id
    @Post('/')             // POST /posts
    @Put('/:id')           // PUT /posts/:id
    @Patch('/:id')         // PATCH /posts/:id
    @Delete('/:id')        // DELETE /posts/:id
}
```

### Named Routes

```typescript
import { route } from '@lockness/core'

@Controller('/users')
export class UserController {
    @Get('/:id', { name: 'users.show' })
    show(c: Context) {
        const id = c.req.param('id')
        return c.json({ id })
    }
}

// Generate URLs
const url = route('users.show', { id: 123 })  // "/users/123"
```

### Route Groups

```typescript
@Controller('/api/v1')
export class ApiController {
    @Get('/users')       // /api/v1/users
    @Get('/posts')       // /api/v1/posts
}
```

## Hono Integration

All Hono middleware available from @lockness/core:

### Authentication

```typescript
import { basicAuth, bearerAuth, jwt } from '@lockness/core'

// HTTP Basic Auth
app.use('/admin/*', basicAuth({ 
    username: 'admin', 
    password: 'secret' 
}))

// Bearer Token
app.use('/api/*', bearerAuth({ 
    token: 'secret-token' 
}))

// JWT
app.use('/api/*', jwt({ 
    secret: 'jwt-secret' 
}))
```

### Security

```typescript
import { cors, csrf, secureHeaders } from '@lockness/core'

// CORS
app.use('*', cors({ 
    origin: 'https://example.com' 
}))

// CSRF protection
app.use('*', csrf())

// Security headers
app.use('*', secureHeaders())
```

### Content Processing

```typescript
import { compress, etag, prettyJSON } from '@lockness/core'

// Compression
app.use('*', compress())

// ETag generation
app.use('*', etag())

// Pretty JSON
app.use('*', prettyJSON())
```

### Request Handling

```typescript
import { bodyLimit, logger, requestId } from '@lockness/core'

// Request logging
app.use('*', logger())

// Body limits
app.use('*', bodyLimit({ 
    maxSize: 50 * 1024 
}))

// Request IDs
app.use('*', requestId())
```

### Utilities

```typescript
import { getCookie, setCookie, html, css } from '@lockness/core'

// Cookies
const value = getCookie(c, 'session')
setCookie(c, 'session', 'abc123')

// HTML/CSS
return c.html(html`<h1>Hello</h1>`)
```

## Error Handling

### Auto-Discovery

Framework checks for custom error handler at:
```
app/view/pages/errors/error_handler.tsx
```

### Custom Error Handler

```typescript
import { Context, formatErrorForConsole, HTTPException } from '@lockness/core'

export function errorHandler(error: Error, c: Context) {
    const status = error instanceof HTTPException ? error.status : 500

    // Clean console output
    formatErrorForConsole(error, status, c.req.path, {
        showStackTrace: status >= 500,
    })

    return c.html(<ErrorPage error={error} />, status)
}
```

### Generate Error Pages

```bash
deno task cli make:error-pages
```

## Complete Example

```typescript
// main.ts
import { App, logger, cors } from '@lockness/core'

const app = new App()

// Global middleware
app.use('*', logger())
app.use('*', cors())

// Initialize
await app.init({
    controllersDir: './app/controller',
    staticDir: 'public',
})

Deno.serve({ port: 8888 }, app.fetch)

// app/controller/user_controller.ts
import { Controller, Get, Post, Inject, Context } from '@lockness/core'
import { UserService } from '../service/user_service.ts'

@Controller('/users')
export class UserController {
    @Inject(UserService)
    accessor userService!: UserService

    @Get('/', { name: 'users.index' })
    async index(c: Context) {
        const users = await this.userService.findAll()
        return c.json({ users })
    }

    @Get('/:id', { name: 'users.show' })
    async show(c: Context) {
        const id = Number(c.req.param('id'))
        const user = await this.userService.findById(id)
        
        if (!user) {
            return c.json({ error: 'Not found' }, 404)
        }

        return c.json({ user })
    }

    @Post('/')
    async store(c: Context) {
        const data = await c.req.json()
        const user = await this.userService.create(data)
        return c.json({ user }, 201)
    }
}

// app/service/user_service.ts
import { Service } from '@lockness/core'

@Service()
export class UserService {
    async findAll() {
        return [
            { id: 1, name: 'Alice' },
            { id: 2, name: 'Bob' },
        ]
    }

    async findById(id: number) {
        return { id, name: 'User' }
    }

    async create(data: any) {
        return { id: 3, ...data }
    }
}
```

## Adding Optional Features

### Sessions

```typescript
import { App } from '@lockness/core'
import { configureSession, sessionMiddleware } from '@lockness/session'

const app = new App()

configureSession({ 
    driver: 'cookie', 
    secret: 'your-secret' 
})

app.use('*', sessionMiddleware())
```

### Validation

```typescript
import { Validate, z } from '@lockness/validator'

const createUserSchema = z.object({
    email: z.string().email(),
    name: z.string().min(2),
})

@Post('/')
@Validate('json', createUserSchema)
async store(c: Context) {
    const data = c.req.valid('json')
    return c.json({ created: true })
}
```

### Background Jobs

```typescript
import { configureQueue, registerJob } from '@lockness/queue'

configureQueue({ driver: 'deno-kv' })
registerJob('send-email', SendEmailJob)
```

### Authentication

```typescript
import { initializeAuthMiddleware, SessionGuard } from '@lockness/auth'

app.use('*', initializeAuthMiddleware({
    default: 'web',
    guards: {
        web: (ctx) => new SessionGuard('web', ctx, userProvider),
    },
}))
```

## API Reference

See detailed documentation in subdocs:

- [Components](llms/components.txt) - JSX components and view system
- [Routing](llms/routing.txt) - Advanced routing patterns
- [Middleware](llms/middleware.txt) - Custom middleware creation
- [Error Handling](llms/error-handling.txt) - Error handling patterns

## Best Practices

- **Keep controllers thin** - Delegate to services
- **Use dependency injection** - Testable and maintainable
- **Follow MVC pattern** - Clear separation of concerns
- **Use named routes** - Easier URL generation
- **Handle errors properly** - Custom error pages and logging
- **Import Hono from core** - Never import from @lockness/hono directly
- **Add features incrementally** - Start minimal, add what you need

## Performance

- Zero overhead decorators (metadata only)
- Fast route matching with Hono
- Efficient controller caching
- Lazy loading of controllers
- Minimal bundle size

## Development

```bash
# Start dev server
deno task dev

# Build for production
deno task build

# Run tests
deno task test
```
